signal_or_failure: Specie suspension of the Chemical Bank with the other twenty New York city banks
magnitude: specie 57661 to 11383; circulation 266969 to 194634; profits 69068; stock 124 to 98
what_it_demonstrated: That this ancestry failed its obligation to pay coin on demand in 1837 as its own history reports it
what_it_did_not_demonstrate: Any failure of the Manhattan line, the Morgan house or the registrant; any figure for depositor losses or note discounts
notes: THE ONLY DOCUMENTED FAILURE OF ANY ANCESTRY IN THE WINDOW. Written as printed with no popular-panic gloss (§M.1).

signal_or_failure: The licensed purpose ends: water service stops about when the Croton system completes
what_it_demonstrated: That the purpose used to obtain the charter was not the durable business
what_it_did_not_demonstrate: That the bank's survival proves the device was wise - a survivor's reading this dossier refuses
notes: Quality dissatisfaction is printed in the same carrier (the Pure Manhattan cartoon).

signal_or_failure: The first manufacturing site sold at a fraction of its price
what_it_demonstrated: That the origin asset was a realised loss within eleven years
what_it_did_not_demonstrate: That it was an accounting loss (no depreciation, inventory or plant value prints) or that manufacture was a mistake at the time

signal_or_failure: The manufacturing purpose is effectively stopped
what_it_demonstrated: That the firm abandoned the object it was incorporated to pursue
what_it_did_not_demonstrate: That the abandonment was forced rather than chosen

signal_or_failure: A consolidation bill with the New York State Bank of Albany fails to pass and the plan is abandoned
what_it_demonstrated: That contemporaries had an expansion path killed by the legislature and not by the market
what_it_did_not_demonstrate: That the failure harmed the bank
notes: One of the corpus's only rejected-option records (§O).

signal_or_failure: The charter nearly defeated on account of its banking clause
magnitude: 'A great effort was made to defeat the charter'
what_it_demonstrated: That the founding instrument was politically precarious at the moment of birth
what_it_did_not_demonstrate: That it would have died without the water framing
notes: The strongest anti-hagiographic datum available: contemporaries tried to stop it.

what_it_demonstrated: That the institution's stability was personally carried
what_it_did_not_demonstrate: That it could not survive - it did

signal_or_failure: A peer institution of the same class and size fails outright
magnitude: Ohio Life Insurance and Trust Company; paid-up capital 2000000; business never resumed
what_it_demonstrated: That an institution of exactly this kind could disappear in the window
what_it_did_not_demonstrate: Anything about the three ancestries' own vulnerability
notes: Kept so that survival in this dossier is not read as inevitability.

signal_or_failure: The panic appears in the corpus only as a firm's 1913 retrospective and as a Tier-4 accusation
what_it_demonstrated: That the Morgan house claimed a stabilising role in 1913
what_it_did_not_demonstrate: Any failure of the Morgan house; any independent account of 1907
notes: The Tier-4 sentences name OTHER banks and are excluded from all counts (§M.4).

signal_or_failure: NOT RECORDDED AS A FAILURE - stated so it is not silently inferred: no suspension insolvency resolution or charter loss is printed for the Manhattan or Morgan lines
what_it_did_not_demonstrate: That these lines were sound: a self-history's silence is its genre not evidence
notes: Routes named at FR-2 and FR-3; general history cannot substitute.
